name: cn.dianyinhuoban.szg.mvp.home.view.HomeActivity
description: The Dianyinhuoban SHENGZHANGUI (DY_SZG) business SDK opens the partner app's main dashboard after startup. It provides the home, machine purchase, training and poster, ranking, and account sections, loads system and identity status, and checks for app updates when an update-check URL is configured.
disableEffect: Disabling it removes the app's main dashboard and navigation, so users cannot reach its main sections.
